description: Use when you SELL or hold a token and do not want to poll: registers a standing search (chain, token, size range) and Bull POSTs the event rfq.new to your https webhook the moment a matching request for quotes appears, with the rfqId to answer with bull_send_quote. Up to 10 watches per wallet, each lasts at most 30 days. Signed call. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

chain.description: Chain slug as listed in /api/v1/trust (optional, default: all chains).

days.description: How long the watch lasts, 1 to 30 days (default 30).

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

webhook.description: Public https URL that receives the event rfq.new.

name: bull_watch_rfqs
